name: Thai Letters Battle
desc:
⭐ Welcome to THAI LETTERS BATTLE!

✅ Find as many Thai words as you can containing the given letters!
⚔️ Battle against other players and see who can find the most words!
🧠 Test your Thai vocabulary and discover new words along the way!
⚡🏆 Compete with your friends and prove who is the ultimate Thai word master!

llm.loop: get given Thai letters -> type as many Thai words containing them as possible -> beat other players
llm.objectives: find the most words and win rounds
llm.instructions: find Thai words containing the given letters and battle other players
monetization_signals: tiny products: reveal 5, prank friend 8, x2 5
llm.thumbnails: two avatars at a table with Thai letter combination and question marks
llm.complexity_notes: word list lookup and round UI
